# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as pale and spiritual-looking. She is golden and fair, and she has been seen dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious student. Despite her spiritual appearance, she is full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- fun-loving  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- writing papers and speaking for society meetings  <sub>[v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- to be famous  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

## History

While studying at Queen's Academy, Priscilla formed an intimate friendship with Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard. During her time at school, Mr. Phillips spent time writing verses to her. She was originally offered the teaching position at Carmody, but she opted to take her own home school instead. She supported the Avonlea Village Improvement Society by writing and reading a paper on cemeteries. Later, she visited Green Gables accompanied by her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan, and Mrs. Pendexter.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)_
